decisions.reason: The 15-day express program costs little to run and supports the fast-delivery promise, but it overlaps with the express line D, so consolidation remains a real possibility without being an immediate necessity.
The 72-hour service reinforces the firm's fast-response positioning, and slack in a large firm in a growing industry lets it continue despite its low visibility and possible folding into line D.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends the core modular Teckentrup 62 system and likely meets aspirations, so no problemistic search is triggered.
The multi-model express line with its own page is central to the firm's fast-delivery strategy and shows no shortfall against aspirations.
The fire and smoke protection door is a compliance-driven core product close to the established offer and unlikely to fall below aspiration levels.
